_doc: P4.D288 (C1-7, L-3): the Commonplace mirror's calls — `commonplace-mirror-tier2.test.ts` and `commonplace_mirror_equivalence.rs` run them in order on ONE copy of the consolidation fixture pair. `sql` runs on main; `mirror` calls mirrorCommonplaceForSubjects / mirror_commonplace_for_subjects; `retire` retires ids (`item-delete`) and the retirement's announcement refreshes the removed digests' buckets.

calls.name: plant_cap
sql: WITH RECURSIVE n(i) AS (SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT i + 1 FROM n WHERE i < 205) INSERT INTO memories (id, characterId, aboutCharacterId, content, summary, importance, source, reinforcedImportance, tier, createdAt, updatedAt) SELECT printf('0c7b0000-0000-4000-8000-%012d', i), '0c020000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001', '0c5b0000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001', printf('Laura detail number %d.', i), printf('cap %d', i), 0.5, 'CONSOLIDATED', 0.3 + (i % 50) / 100.0, 'hot', printf('2026-08-01T00:%02d:%02d.000Z', i / 60, i % 60), '2026-08-01T00:00:00.000Z' FROM n

projections.name: links
projections.sql: SELECT l.mountPointId, l.relativePath, l.fileName, f.fileType, f.sha256, f.fileSizeBytes, f.source, d.content, d.contentSha256, d.plainTextLength, l.chunkCount, l.conversionStatus, l.extractionStatus, l.plainTextLength AS linkPlainTextLength FROM doc_mount_file_links l JOIN doc_mount_files f ON f.id = l.fileId LEFT JOIN doc_mount_documents d ON d.fileId = f.id WHERE l.relativePath LIKE 'Commonplace/%' ORDER BY l.relativePath, d.content

projections.name: folders
projections.sql: SELECT f.mountPointId, f.name, f.path, p.path AS parentPath FROM doc_mount_folders f LEFT JOIN doc_mount_folders p ON p.id = f.parentId WHERE f.path LIKE 'Commonplace%' ORDER BY f.path, f.mountPointId

projections.name: chunks
projections.sql: SELECT c.mountPointId, l.relativePath, c.chunkIndex, c.content, c.tokenCount, c.headingContext FROM doc_mount_chunks c JOIN doc_mount_file_links l ON l.id = c.linkId WHERE l.relativePath LIKE 'Commonplace/%' ORDER BY l.relativePath, c.content, c.chunkIndex
